verdict.rationale: A commerce and payments platform could plausibly offer background automations, so the axis applies. The pack only shows developer building blocks: webhooks, an MCP server, SDKs and offline payments. It never documents a Square feature for setting up autonomous, recurring or background automations; 'schedule and pay your team' is staff scheduling, a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
